rationale: Russia struck cargo vessels and steel plants across Ukraine; UN warns of toughest winter since invasion with power and water access threatened.

top_events.title: Russia strikes cargo vessels, steel plants across Ukraine

top_events.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
top_events.label: UN warns Ukraine faces toughest winter yet
top_events.summary: A senior UN official warned of a race against time to ensure Ukrainian access to power and water through the coming winter, the toughest since the full-scale invasion began.
